name: Ben Tre to Can Tho
summary: Go by road. It is about 110 km and about three hours by minibus. Leave in the morning: the direct minibuses run only a few times a day and stop in the early afternoon. There is no train.

modes.note: About 110 km. Non-air-conditioned 30-seat minibuses leave a few times a day, the last around 13:30. Departure point and fares are Check on arrival.
Private cars and taxis run the same roads. A driving time is Check on arrival.
There is no railway in the Mekong Delta.

seoTitle: Ben Tre to Can Tho — minibus or car
seoDescription: About 110 km and about three hours by minibus from Ben Tre to Can Tho. Leave by early afternoon. No train.

faqs.q: Do you have to go back through Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: No. Minibuses run directly between Ben Tre and Can Tho, a few times a day until early afternoon.
